title: #219 LIFE-24: integrations/ ships versioned example hc templates for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Grok and a local agent, a manifest with each template's version and digest, and a README; Chough never runs hc, Herdr or Rune
description: #219 LIFE-24: integrations/ ships versioned example hc templates for Claude Code, Codex, Kimi, Grok and a local agent, a manifest with each template's version and digest, and a README; Chough never runs hc, Herdr or Rune
acceptance_criteria: integrations/ holds a README and one hc template per host (claude-code, codex, kimi, grok, local) whose front matter is exactly name, description and command, whose body runs chough next and loads the skill file its own chough init --host creates, with no absolute or home path; integrations/templates.toml lists each with its init host, status (local unqualified until #220) and an ordered versions list with their SHA-256, and tests/integrations.rs fails while a template differs from its newest listed digest, its versions skip, or a digest repeats (an in-place edit of a listed entry is left to review); src/ never runs hc, Herdr or Rune and the skill never names Herdr or Rune (red then green in tests/integrations.rs)

answers.constraints: LIFE-24: no runtime dependency on hc, Herdr or Rune, and Rune stays a separate Fledge plugin; LIFE-26: committed files hold no local paths or user names; docs/integrations.md host mappings (Kimi uses --host openai; Codex was observed through the openai mapping); hc's own guidance that Codex runs with --no-daemon
